tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background for every screen. HQ theme (MVA-297).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, table bodies on ground.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Selected rows, open menus, the active tab.

tokens.name: deep
tokens.usage: Sidebar, nav strip, panel headers, footers; the darkest band on a screen.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, table rules, panel borders. Decorative only; never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders; 3:1+ on every surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, metadata, DTGs on every surface.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Gold. Primary buttons, active nav, the display name, key numbers. As text on any surface.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Label on a primary fill.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: copper (from the logo's star, lifted for contrast). The one thing that needs attention: next op, objective, unread. One per panel.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label on an accent fill.

tokens.name: go
tokens.usage: GO, confirmed, RSVP yes. Always with the word.

tokens.name: pending
tokens.usage: PENDING, awaiting RSVP. Always with the word.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: NO-GO, abort, overdue. Always with the word; shown as a filled chip so it never reads as accent.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 3px offset, every interactive element.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Search and input field fill.

tokens.name: surface-top
tokens.usage: Light end of the panel gradient (145deg, surface-top to surface). Text pairs are tested on it.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Row hover. The worst-case background for text; every text token must clear 4.5:1 here.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Footers, column heads, placeholders, counts, separators. One token for the eleven lower greys in the v0 export; at least 4.8:1 on every surface (Lord, MVA-297).

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Hover and active text on primary.

tokens.name: alert-fill
tokens.usage: Solid fill behind a count badge. Text on it is on-primary (4.92:1).

tokens.name: tint-sage
tokens.usage: Chip and avatar fill, sage. Text: on-tint-sage.

tokens.name: on-tint-sage
tokens.usage: Text on tint-sage.

tokens.name: tint-sand
tokens.usage: Chip and avatar fill, sand. Text: on-tint-sand.

tokens.name: on-tint-sand
tokens.usage: Text on tint-sand.

tokens.name: tint-steel
tokens.usage: Chip fill, steel. Text: on-tint-steel.

tokens.name: on-tint-steel
tokens.usage: Text on tint-steel.

tokens.name: tint-clay
tokens.usage: Avatar fill, clay. Text: on-tint-clay.

tokens.name: on-tint-clay
tokens.usage: Text on tint-clay.

tokens.name: tint-notice
tokens.usage: Notice and warning fill. Text: on-tint-notice; border: notice-line.

tokens.name: on-tint-notice
tokens.usage: Text on tint-notice.

tokens.name: notice-line
tokens.usage: Notice border. Decorative; the notice also carries a word.

tokens.name: mark-navy
tokens.usage: Logo colour, exact from the source file. Print and merch only, not UI.

tokens.name: mark-red
tokens.usage: Logo colour, exact. Print and merch only.

tokens.name: mark-gold
tokens.usage: Logo colour, exact. Print and merch only.

tokens.name: mark-copper
tokens.usage: Logo colour, exact (the star). The UI accent in Field is its lifted cousin.

tokens.name: mark-ink
tokens.usage: Logo colour, exact (the ZULU letters).

styles.name: field-hero
styles.usage: Splash and section heroes, once per screen.

styles.name: field-heading
styles.usage: Panel and OPORD paragraph heads, uppercase.

styles.name: field-label
styles.usage: Field labels, nav, status bar, uppercase.

styles.name: field-body
styles.sample: Stage at the east gate by 0630. Comms check on channel 4.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding, row gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding, control padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gutters between panels, screen side margins.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero spacing on splash.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Square corners where a hard edge is wanted (tables, the splash stripe, the logo frame).

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Status chips and tier badges.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Controls: buttons, inputs, small rows.

tokens.name: radius-3
tokens.usage: Panels and cards.

tokens.name: radius-4
tokens.usage: Largest surfaces: the page shell, modals.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots, the logo disc, avatars.
